test_title: PYST 16: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 11 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Although Tania and her friend are __poles apart__, they still love each other.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **completely different and opposite**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"poles apart"** means being completely different in every way, having no similarity at all. (एकदम विपरीत)

 
 
• **Example:** Despite being poles apart in their beliefs, they managed to maintain a strong friendship.
 
 
 
• **"Completely different and opposite"** refers to things or people that are entirely unlike each other in nature, characteristics, or opinions. (पूरी तरह अलग और विपरीत)
 
 
• **Example:** The two siblings are completely different and opposite in their approach to life.
 
 
 
• Thus, the phrase "poles apart" is best replaced by "completely different and opposite."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **completely different and opposite**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Completely similar** (पूरी तरह समान): Refers to things that are exactly alike or identical.

 
 
• **Example:** The twins are completely similar in appearance, but their personalities differ.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Arrogant and cruel** (घमंडी और क्रूर): Describes someone who has excessive pride and behaves harshly or unkindly.
 
 
• **Example:** The arrogant and cruel king was disliked by his subjects.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Imperfect by all means** (सभी दृष्टियों से अपूर्ण): Refers to something that has flaws or lacks perfection in every aspect.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite being imperfect by all means, the painting still held a certain charm.
 
 

36:Tcc4,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
